entities.name: Tanek
entities.description: A guildless young pickpocket who sleeps on a rooftop and steals a purse from Benakov.

entities.name: Radomir
entities.description: A Boros Legion soldier who catches Tanek, recovers the purse and recruits him as an informant.

entities.name: Busa
entities.description: A chicken vendor and Tanek's favorite, harassed by Orzhov thugs for protection money.

entities.name: Ambroz Benakov
entities.description: A fat Orzhov extortionist whose thugs squeeze market vendors for protection money.

entities.name: Migen
entities.description: A pickpocket who lives on the rooftop with Tanek.

entities.name: Erika
entities.description: A pickpocket who lives on the rooftop with Tanek and works with a distracting sad little girl.

entities.name: Ivo
entities.description: A thief who lives on the rooftop and watches from the shadows.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose patrolmen watch the market.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose thugs extort the market.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that mints newer zino coins.

entities.name: smelting district marketplace
entities.description: A market of guildless metalworkers and a thief's paradise.

events.summary: Tanek wakes on the rooftop, counts his coins and heads to the smelting district marketplace.
events.quote: Tanek made his way through the busy streets to the smelting district marketplace.

events.summary: Orzhov thugs harass Busa in front of Boros patrolmen, raising the protection rate.
events.quote: Today they doubled the rate and said they'd cut my daughter's toes off if I didn't pay on time.

events.summary: Benakov arrives with an entourage to buy pastries.
events.quote: Master Benakov, the pastry merchant you were inquiring about is this way.

events.summary: Tanek trips Benakov and steals his coin purse, then flees into an alley.
events.quote: Tanek tossed the board in the way.

events.summary: Radomir of the Boros Legion catches Tanek at a dead-end wall and takes the purse.
events.quote: In an instant, the heel of the man's boot was on his neck, followed by the point of his sword.

events.summary: Tanek explains Benakov's men threatened Busa and others.
events.quote: Those thugs you were watching are Ambroz Benakov's men.

events.summary: Radomir recruits Tanek as an informant, pays him two ten-zino coins and leaves.
events.quote: drop a note in the empty planter on the roof of the goblin forge.

events.summary: Tanek returns to the rooftop, learns Erika and Migen stole from a victim, and decides to leave for a different rooftop.

relations.quote: I'm Radomir of the Boros Legion.
Those thugs you were watching are Ambroz Benakov's men.

relations.note: fat man in Orzhov black and white robes with an Orzhov guard
relations.quote: An armored guard in an Orzhov surcoat came first

relations.note: Busa is his friend and favorite vendor
